title: The localization scale of the block Anderson model in one dimension at arbitrary coupling and volume
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib proof of the main results of Yin, "The Localization Scale of the Block Anderson Model in One Dimension at Arbitrary Coupling and Volume" (arXiv:2611.09776). The model is H = (g (S + S^{-1}) tensor I_W + diag(V_1, ..., V_L)) / max{1, g} on C^L tensor C^W, with independent GUE blocks V_a of size W and the cyclic shift S of Z_L. Theorem 1.4: for 0 < kappa < 1/2 and all D, tau > 0, for all large W, every L >= 3 and every coupling g >= 0, the expected fraction of the eigenvalues in the bulk energy set J_{g,kappa,L} that are simple and whose eigenvector has localization length between W^{-tau} l and W^{tau} l, where l = min{WL, max{W, W^2 g^2}}, is at least 1 - W^{-D}. Corollary 1.5: if also L <= W^{B_L}, then with probability at least 1 - W^{-D} this holds for every eigenvalue in J_{g,kappa,L}. No result of another work is assumed; every result that the paper uses is proved in the library from Mathlib.
